qualification.details: For all posts, eligibility is decided strictly on the basis of the Academic/Research Score obtained under Appendix II, Table 2 of the UGC Regulations, 2018. Candidates must also meet all the essential criteria the UGC Regulations, 2018 lay down for direct recruitment to the post. Three posts have their own qualifications, given in Annexures 1 to 3 of the notice. The notice also attaches the UGC Regulations, 2018 in Hindi. | The attached UGC Regulations, 2018 give two routes for Professor: | Route A: an eminent scholar with a Ph.D. in the concerned/allied/relevant subject. The scholar must have high-quality published work in peer-reviewed or UGC-listed journals and be actively engaged in research, with evidence of published work. A total research score of 120 under Appendix II, Table 2 is also required. Route A also requires at least ten years of teaching experience as Assistant Professor/Associate Professor/Professor in a university or college, and/or research experience at an equivalent level in a university or national-level institution. The candidate must show evidence of having successfully guided doctoral candidates. Route B: an outstanding professional with a Ph.D. in a relevant/allied/applied discipline, from any institution or industry not covered under Route A. The professional must have made a significant contribution to knowledge in the concerned subject, supported by documentary evidence, and must have ten years' experience. | The candidate needs the required teaching experience, the requisite API/research score and the minimum number of research publications as per UGC Regulations, 2018. The candidate must also hold the minimum essential qualification below. Qualification option 1: a Master's degree in Hindi/History/Political Science/Public Administration/Education/Economics/Gandhian Studies with 55% marks (50% for SC/ST) or an equivalent grade. This must be combined with an MA/PG Diploma (one year)/Diploma (one year) in Deen Dayal Upadhyay Studies/Philosophy/Thoughts/Contribution, from an Indian University or an equivalent degree from an accredited foreign university. The candidate must also have cleared NET in one of these subjects (UGC or CSIR), or a similar UGC-accredited test such as SLET/SET. OR qualification option 2: the same Master's degree with 55% marks (50% for SC/ST), and a PhD in any of Social Science/Education/Economics/Hindi/Gandhian Studies specifically on a topic related to Deen Dayal Upadhyay Studies/Philosophy/Thoughts/Contribution. The candidate must be an eminent scholar with a Ph.D. in one of the above subjects and high-quality published work. A minimum of 10 research publications is required, of which 8 must be on Deen Dayal Upadhyay Studies/Philosophy/Thoughts/Contribution, in peer-reviewed or UGC-CARE listed journals. A total research score of 120 under Appendix II, Table 2 is also required. The candidate needs at least ten years of teaching experience as Assistant Professor/Associate Professor/Professor in a college, university or national-level institution, with evidence of having successfully guided a doctoral candidate. | Route A (i): an eminent scholar with a Ph.D. in the concerned/allied/relevant subject. The scholar must have high-quality published work, be actively engaged in research, have publications in peer-reviewed or UGC-listed journals, and hold a total research score of 120 under Appendix-II, Table 2. Route A (ii): at least ten years of teaching experience at Assistant Professor/Associate Professor/Professor level in a university or college, and/or research experience at an equivalent level in a university or national-level institution, with evidence of successfully guiding doctoral candidates. Route B: an outstanding professional with a Ph.D. in a relevant/allied/applied discipline from any institution not included under Route A. The professional must have made a significant contribution to knowledge in the subject, supported by documentary evidence, and must have ten years' experience. Under both routes, the candidate must belong to the faculty of Social Sciences, Languages, Humanities or Arts, and must have worked or be working on the subject of Jammu-Kashmir. This post carries 01 vacancy (UR-01) at Academic Level-14 (Rs. 1,44,200/- to Rs. 2,18,200/-). | A good academic record with a Ph.D. degree in the concerned/allied/relevant disciplines. At least eight years of experience of teaching and/or research in an academic/research position equivalent to Assistant Professor, in a university, college or accredited research institution/industry. A minimum of seven publications in peer-reviewed or UGC-listed journals and a total research score of 75 under Appendix II, Table 2. | Essential: a good academic record with a Ph.D. degree in the concerned/allied/relevant disciplines. Essential: a Master's degree with first class (or an equivalent grade) in Hospitality/Hotel Administration/Hotel Management, from an Indian University or an equivalent degree from an accredited foreign university. Essential: at least eight years of experience of teaching and/or research in an academic/research position equivalent to Assistant Professor. The experience may be in a University/College/Accredited Research Institution/hotel industry (4 Star and above category hotels). A minimum of seven publications in peer-reviewed or UGC-listed journals and a total research score of 75 under Appendix II, Table 2 are also required. content_sections.heading: About CUHP
content_sections.text: Central University of Himachal Pradesh is a central university whose camp office is near the HPCA Cricket Stadium in Dharamshala, District Kangra, Himachal Pradesh. Employment Notice No. 002/2026 is issued by the Registrar. It covers teaching positions in the university's departments and centres, including the HP Kendriya Vishwavidyalaya Business School, the Centre for Deen Dayal Upadhyay Studies and the Centre for Kashmir Studies.

content_sections.heading: Department-wise Vacancies
content_sections.text: The notice lists 15 regular vacancies (10 Professor, 5 Associate Professor) and 2 Associate Professor posts against lien vacancy, a total of 17. No Assistant Professor post is advertised in either table. The notice says these posts are likely to be regularised subject to termination of the lien on the post. Three posts carry a PwD marking within their category: Professor in Animal Science (OBC, PWD-OH), and Associate Professor in Computer Science and Informatics and in Political Science (both SC, PWD-VH).

content_sections.heading: Selection Process
content_sections.text: Shortlisting is based on the Academic/Research Score as per Appendix II, Table 2 of the UGC Regulations, 2018, and is followed by an interview. Mere eligibility does not entitle a candidate to be called for interview. Original certificates are required at the time of interview only. An applicant who has good and sufficient reasons may ask to be considered in absentia. The Selection Committee may then consider the candidature on the recommendation of the Screening Committee, but only after prior approval of the Vice-Chancellor. The University also reserves the right to consider and invite exceptionally suitable candidates in absentia. The Vice-Chancellor's decision on eligibility, acceptance or rejection of applications, mode of selection and conduct of interview is final.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for CUHP Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Applications are accepted only in online mode on the CU Chayan Portal. The link opened on 18 November 2026, and applications must be received by 18 December 2026 . An application sent only by Registered/Speed Post, without online submission, will be rejected. Open the CU Chayan Portal and fill in the online application form for the post you want. Enter a correct email address and mobile number. The University is not responsible for wrong contact details. Upload legible copies of all relevant documents claimed in the form, including the NOC if you are in service. Pay the application processing fee and examination fee for your category. To apply for more than one post, submit a separate application for each post with its own fee. Submit the application with all necessary documents before 18 December 2026. Incomplete applications will be summarily rejected. The application processing fee once paid will not be refunded at any stage. The notice does not mention the mode of fee payment.

content_sections.heading: Documents Required
content_sections.text: Legible copies of all relevant documents claimed in the online application form. Matriculation/SSC certificate or passing certificate issued by the educational board. This is the only document accepted as proof of date of birth. SC/ST/OBC/EWS/PwD certificate in the prescribed Government of India proforma, for reserved-category candidates. OBC (Non Creamy Layer)/EWS certificate from the Competent Authority, not older than 06 months from the last date of receipt of applications, for posts reserved for OBC/EWS. Without it, the candidature will be rejected. NOC from the employer for in-service candidates of Govt./Private Universities/Colleges/Autonomous bodies. The NOC must state that no vigilance case is pending or contemplated against the candidate. Equivalence Certificate from the AIU, New Delhi, for a Ph.D. from a foreign university (unless exempted as stated above). Original certificates, to be produced at the time of interview.

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are there in CUHP Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 17 posts: 10 Professor posts and 7 Associate Professor posts. Five of the Associate Professor posts are regular vacancies and 2 are against lien vacancy.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply for CUHP Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date of receipt of online applications is 18 December 2026. The application link opened on 18 November 2026.

faq.question: Q3. What is the qualification for CUHP Professor and Associate Professor posts?
faq.answer: Eligibility follows the UGC Regulations, 2018 and is assessed on the Academic/Research Score. Associate Professor needs a Ph.D., a Master's degree with 55% marks and eight years' experience. Professor needs a Ph.D., a research score of 120 and ten years' experience.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary for CUHP Professor and Associate Professor?
faq.answer: Professor is at Academic Level-14 (Rs. 1,44,200/- to Rs. 2,18,200/-). Associate Professor is at Academic Level-13A (Rs. 1,31,400/- to Rs. 2,17,100/-).

faq.question: Q5. What is the application fee for CUHP Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: UR/OBC(NCL)/EWS candidates pay Rs. 1750/- (Rs. 250/- processing fee plus Rs. 1500/- examination fee). SC/ST/PwD/Women candidates of all categories pay Rs. 1500/-, the examination fee only.

faq.question: Q6. How do I apply for CUHP Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Apply online on the CU Chayan Portal and upload all the documents you claim, by 18 December 2026. Applications sent only by Registered/Speed Post, without online submission, are rejected.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for CUHP faculty posts?
faq.answer: Candidates are shortlisted on the Academic/Research Score under Appendix II, Table 2 of the UGC Regulations, 2018, and are then called for interview. Mere eligibility does not guarantee an interview call.

faq.question: Q8. Can I apply for more than one post in CUHP Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Yes. A candidate must submit a separate application for each post, with the requisite application processing fee for each.

faq.question: Q9. Are the CUHP Associate Professor lien vacancy posts permanent?
faq.answer: The two lien vacancy posts last as long as the incumbent keeps the lien and are likely to be regularised once the lien ends. The appointment ends forthwith if the incumbent is repatriated.

faq.question: Q10. Do in-service candidates need an NOC for CUHP Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Yes. In-service candidates of Govt./Private Universities/Colleges/Autonomous bodies must upload an NOC from their employer when applying. The NOC must state that no vigilance case is pending or contemplated against them.
